description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 011 are a fine lattice jali panel, shown in the product photo as several fine lattice designs grouped in a light, sandstone-coloured frame, suited to window openings, entrances and feature walls where detail is seen up close.

## How it looks
The photo shows a panel that combines more than one fine lattice pattern, set in a pale frame that reads like sandstone rather than red clay. Fine openings give more privacy than open grids and recall the carved stone screens of Mughal buildings. The light colour tends to suit cream plaster, marble and lighter interiors.

## Where it works
- **Jali window panel** in place of grills, giving privacy and filtered light.
- **Mixed jali design panel** as a framed feature at an entrance, stair landing or prayer room.
- **Sandstone colour jali** where red terracotta would be too warm for the colour scheme.

Because the lattice is fine, it is best placed where people see it from close by, such as a foyer or courtyard wall.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Design: mixed fine lattice patterns in a light, sandstone-coloured frame (from the product photo)
- Material colour and panel size are not listed online yet; confirm the exact colour, size and thickness before you order.

Fine openings collect dust, so clean with a soft dry brush and a damp cloth; avoid acid cleaners. For a window, ask your contractor how the panel will be framed and sealed against rain.

## See it before you order
Fine detail is easiest to judge in person. Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm, or ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your opening size for a dated quote. Read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide) or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of a fine lattice jali panel?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can a jali panel replace a window grill?
faqs.a: It often does in Pakistani homes, giving privacy and light. The panel needs a proper frame and, if exposed to rain, a sealing detail from your contractor.

faqs.q: Fine lattice jali or open grid jali: which gives more privacy?
faqs.a: Fine lattice gives more privacy and a more detailed, traditional look; an open grid gives more airflow and a modern look.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 011" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
